**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

I checked the Fees section (4.1–4.4), Exhibit B pricing/revenue sharing and Payment Terms, Term and Termination (Section 11), Limitation of Liability (Section 9), and ran targeted searches for "liquidated damages", "penalt", "minimum" and "interest".

Key points:
- No liquidated damages, penalty, or "shall pay … as liquidated damages" language appears anywhere in the Agreement.
- Corio's payment obligations are ordinary license, maintenance/support, MarketSite access, implementation and revenue-share fees — no minimum commitment, shortfall guarantee, or early-termination/accelerated fee.
- Section 11 allows termination for uncured material breach or by non-renewal notice with no termination charge; Section 11.3 continues fees only where we elect to keep supporting existing Customers or receiving maintenance.
- No late-payment interest or penalty clause; the Section 4.4 audit true-up (shortfall payment plus audit costs on a >5% underpayment) is cost recovery, not a penalty.

This satisfies the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties), so the rule is met without needing the 3-month early-termination-fee fallback.
